title: vtc-00: ask-to-unmute cannot be accepted
description: With participantsCanUnmute false, unmuting is forbidden (draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:263,:899), but ask-to-unmute (:931) expects the participant to unmute. :263 also says moderators may 'unmute them directly', which :928 does not list and guides forbid.
close_reason: Participant with unmuteRequested true may unmute despite policy; removed 'unmute them directly'.
